CREATE TABLE branches (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	city VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	latitude NUMERIC(9, 6), 
	longitude NUMERIC(9, 6), 
	is_default BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL,

	CONSTRAINT uq_branches_name_tenant UNIQUE (name, tenant_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE categories (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_categories_tenant_name UNIQUE (tenant_id, name), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE expert_replenishment_rules (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	lookback_days INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	coverage_days INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	is_auto_enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE roles (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id UUID, 
	code VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	base_rol rolenum, 
	is_system BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_roles_tenant_code UNIQUE (tenant_id, code), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE seasons (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_seasons_tenant_name UNIQUE (tenant_id, name), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE tenant_subscriptions (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	plan_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, 
	billing_cycle billingcycleenum NOT NULL, 
	status subscriptionstatusenum NOT NULL, 
	payment_method subscriptionpaymentmethodenum NOT NULL, 
	amount NUMERIC(10, 2), 
	start_date TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	end_date TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(plan_id) REFERENCES saas_plans (id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
)

CREATE TABLE collections (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	season_id UUID, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_collections_tenant_name UNIQUE (tenant_id, name), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(season_id) REFERENCES seasons (id)
)

CREATE TABLE role_permissions (
	role_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	permission_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (role_id, permission_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(role_id) REFERENCES roles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(permission_id) REFERENCES permissions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE users (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id UUID, 
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	email VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	hashed_password VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	gender genderenum NOT NULL, 
	rol rolenum NOT NULL, 
	branch_id UUID, 
	is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(branch_id) REFERENCES branches (id)
)
ddl_indices: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_users_email ON users (email)

CREATE TABLE cash_sessions (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	branch_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	cashier_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	opening_amount NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL, 
	opened_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	expected_amount NUMERIC(10, 2), 
	counted_amount NUMERIC(10, 2), 
	difference NUMERIC(10, 2), 
	closing_note VARCHAR(255), 
	closed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(branch_id) REFERENCES branches (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(cashier_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)
ddl_indices: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_cash_sessions_open_cashier ON cash_sessions (cashier_id) WHERE status = 'open'

CREATE TABLE gift_cards (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id UUID, 
	buyer_id UUID, 
	code VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	amount NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL, 
	balance NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL, 
	recipient_name VARCHAR(120) NOT NULL, 
	recipient_email VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	custom_message TEXT, 
	status VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'active' NOT NULL,

	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id) ON DELETE SET NULL,

CREATE TABLE loyalty_accounts (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	user_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	points_balance INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	lifetime_points INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_loyalty_account_tenant_user UNIQUE (tenant_id, user_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE notifications (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	user_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	title VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	body VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	data JSON NOT NULL, 
	read_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	dedupe_key VARCHAR, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)
ddl_indices: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_notifications_dedupe_key ON notifications (dedupe_key)

CREATE TABLE payment_receipts (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	issuer VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	series VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	number INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	kind VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	source_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	branch_id UUID, 
	customer_id UUID, 
	customer_name VARCHAR(150), 
	customer_email VARCHAR(255), 
	payment_method VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	currency VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	total NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL, 
	lines JSONB NOT NULL, 
	summary JSONB NOT NULL, 
	issued_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	emailed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	email_attempts INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_payment_receipts_series_number UNIQUE (series, number), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_payment_receipts_source UNIQUE (kind, source_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(branch_id) REFERENCES branches (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(customer_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE promotion_codes (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	code VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	discount_type VARCHAR(20) NOT NULL, 
	discount_value NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL, 
	valid_from TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	valid_until TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	branch_id UUID, 
	created_by UUID NOT NULL, 
	is_active BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(branch_id) REFERENCES branches (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(created_by) REFERENCES users (id)
)
ddl_indices: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_promotion_codes_code ON promotion_codes (code)

	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	user_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	business_name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	contact_name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	phone VARCHAR, 
	status providerstatusenum NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,

)
ddl_indices: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_providers_user_id ON providers (user_id)

CREATE TABLE qr_payments (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	reference VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL, 
	purpose VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	source_id UUID, 
	branch_id UUID, 
	created_by UUID NOT NULL, 
	amount NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL, 
	currency VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(10) DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	paid_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	UNIQUE (reference), 
	FOREIGN KEY(branch_id) REFERENCES branches (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(created_by) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE rpa_ingest_jobs (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	uploaded_by UUID NOT NULL, 
	filename VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL, 
	mime_type VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL, 
	extracted_items JSON NOT NULL, 
	error_message TEXT, 
	target_branch_id UUID, 
	committed_by UUID, 
	committed_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(uploaded_by) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(target_branch_id) REFERENCES branches (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(committed_by) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE settlements (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	period_date DATE NOT NULL, 
	gross_amount NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL, 
	fee_amount NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL, 
	net_amount NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL, 
	transactions_count INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	currency VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(10) DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL, 
	bank_name VARCHAR(120), 
	bank_account_number VARCHAR(40), 
	bank_account_holder VARCHAR(160), 
	transfer_reference VARCHAR(120), 
	paid_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	paid_by UUID, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_settlements_tenant_period UNIQUE (tenant_id, period_date), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(paid_by) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE user_body_profiles (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	user_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	top_size VARCHAR(32), 
	bottom_size VARCHAR(32), 
	shoe_size VARCHAR(32), 
	body_shape VARCHAR(64), 
	fit_preference VARCHAR(64), 
	notes TEXT, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_user_body_profiles_user_id UNIQUE (user_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE user_roles (
	user_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	role_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (user_id, role_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(role_id) REFERENCES roles (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE user_wallets (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	user_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	balance NUMERIC(10, 2) DEFAULT '0.00' NOT NULL, 
	currency VARCHAR(10) DEFAULT 'BOB' NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
ddl_indices: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_user_wallets_user_id ON user_wallets (user_id)

CREATE TABLE carts (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id UUID, 
	branch_id UUID, 
	user_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	promotion_code_id UUID, 
	status cartstatusenum NOT NULL, 
	subtotal NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL, 
	discount_amount NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL, 
	total_amount NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(branch_id) REFERENCES branches (id) ON DELETE SET NULL, 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(promotion_code_id) REFERENCES promotion_codes (id)
)
ddl_indices: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX ix_carts_user_id ON carts (user_id)

CREATE TABLE cash_movements (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	session_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	type VARCHAR(12) NOT NULL, 
	method VARCHAR(6) NOT NULL, 
	amount NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL, 
	cash_received NUMERIC(10, 2), 
	change_given NUMERIC(10, 2), 
	source_id UUID, 
	reason VARCHAR(255), 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(session_id) REFERENCES cash_sessions (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE conversation_messages (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	conversation_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	role VARCHAR(9) NOT NULL, 
	content TEXT NOT NULL, 
	message_data JSON, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_conversation_messages_role CHECK (role IN ('user', 'assistant')), 
	FOREIGN KEY(conversation_id) REFERENCES conversations (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

tablas.doc: Every movement of points; (source_type, source_id, type) makes each movement idempotent.
tablas.ddl:
CREATE TABLE loyalty_ledger (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	account_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	type VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	points INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	source_type VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	source_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_loyalty_ledger_source_type UNIQUE (source_type, source_id, type), 
	FOREIGN KEY(account_id) REFERENCES loyalty_accounts (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE orders (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	user_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	promotion_code_id UUID, 
	status orderstatusenum NOT NULL, 
	payment_method paymentmethodenum NOT NULL, 
	payment_status paymentstatusenum NOT NULL, 
	stripe_payment_intent_id VARCHAR, 
	cash_reference VARCHAR, 
	pickup_branch_id UUID, 
	pickup_expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	pickup_code VARCHAR, 
	fulfillment_status fulfillmentstatusenum, 
	subtotal NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL, 
	discount_amount NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL, 
	total_amount NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL, 
	fulfillment_type VARCHAR(10) DEFAULT 'pickup' NOT NULL, 
	delivery_address VARCHAR(255), 
	delivery_reference VARCHAR(255), 
	delivery_latitude NUMERIC(9, 6), 
	delivery_longitude NUMERIC(9, 6), 
	delivery_distance_km NUMERIC(6, 2), 
	shipping_cost NUMERIC(10, 2) DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	deposit_applied NUMERIC(10, 2) DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	loyalty_discount NUMERIC(10, 2) DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	delivery_pin VARCHAR(4), 
	delivery_driver_id UUID, 
	delivered_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	currency VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(promotion_code_id) REFERENCES promotion_codes (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(pickup_branch_id) REFERENCES branches (id), 
	UNIQUE (pickup_code), 
	FOREIGN KEY(delivery_driver_id) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE payment_transactions (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	source_type VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	source_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	method VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	gross_amount NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL, 
	fee_amount NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL, 
	net_amount NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL, 
	currency VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	provider_reference VARCHAR(120), 
	settlement_id UUID, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_payment_transactions_source UNIQUE (source_type, source_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(settlement_id) REFERENCES settlements (id)
)

CREATE TABLE products (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	name VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	description TEXT, 
	provider_id UUID, 
	category_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	collection_id UUID, 
	discount_type VARCHAR(20), 
	discount_value NUMERIC(10, 2), 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(provider_id) REFERENCES providers (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(category_id) REFERENCES categories (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(collection_id) REFERENCES collections (id)
)

CREATE TABLE promotion_code_usages (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	promotion_code_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	user_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	used_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_promotion_code_usage_user UNIQUE (promotion_code_id, user_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(promotion_code_id) REFERENCES promotion_codes (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(user_id) REFERENCES users (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE replenishment_requests (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	provider_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	branch_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	requested_by UUID NOT NULL, 
	status replenishmentstatusenum NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	updated_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	accepted_by UUID, 
	accepted_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	preparing_by UUID, 
	preparing_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	awaiting_receipt_by UUID, 
	awaiting_receipt_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	delivered_by UUID, 
	delivered_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(provider_id) REFERENCES providers (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(branch_id) REFERENCES branches (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(requested_by) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(accepted_by) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(preparing_by) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(awaiting_receipt_by) REFERENCES users (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(delivered_by) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE wallet_transactions (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	wallet_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	type VARCHAR(10) NOT NULL, 
	amount NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL, 
	balance_after NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL, 
	concept VARCHAR(30) NOT NULL, 
	source_type VARCHAR(30), 
	source_id UUID, 
	description VARCHAR(255), 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id),

	quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	unit_price NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_cart_item_cart_variant UNIQUE (cart_id, variant_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(cart_id) REFERENCES carts (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(reservation_id) REFERENCES reservations (id),

CREATE TABLE expert_transfer_suggestions (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	variant_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	source_branch_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	target_branch_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	suggested_quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	reason TEXT NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	applied_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(variant_id) REFERENCES product_variants (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(source_branch_id) REFERENCES branches (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(target_branch_id) REFERENCES branches (id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE inventory (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	variant_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	branch_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	reserved_quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	minimum_stock INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_inventory_variant_branch UNIQUE (variant_id, branch_id), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_inventory_minimum_stock_non_negative CHECK (minimum_stock >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_inventory_quantity_non_negative CHECK (quantity >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_inventory_reserved_non_negative CHECK (reserved_quantity >= 0), 
	CONSTRAINT ck_inventory_reserved_within_quantity CHECK (reserved_quantity <= quantity), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(variant_id) REFERENCES product_variants (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(branch_id) REFERENCES branches (id)
)

CREATE TABLE inventory_movements (
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	variant_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	branch_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	movement_type inventorymovementtypeenum NOT NULL, 
	quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	reference_branch_id UUID, 
	note TEXT, 
	created_by UUID, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE DEFAULT now() NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id) REFERENCES tenants (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, 
	FOREIGN KEY(variant_id) REFERENCES product_variants (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(branch_id) REFERENCES branches (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(reference_branch_id) REFERENCES branches (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(created_by) REFERENCES users (id)
)

CREATE TABLE order_items (
	id UUID NOT NULL,

	unit_price NUMERIC(10, 2) NOT NULL,

	variant_sku VARCHAR NOT NULL, 
	size_id UUID, 
	color_id UUID, 
	image_url VARCHAR, 
	image_public_id VARCHAR, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_order_item_order_variant UNIQUE (order_id, variant_id),

	FOREIGN KEY(reservation_id) REFERENCES reservations (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(variant_id) REFERENCES product_variants (id)
)

	provider_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	variant_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	quantity INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id),
